result.title: HyrCap: Hybrid Rank-Calibration of Action Proposals for Temporal Event Understanding
result.comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 4 tables. Project page: https://zgca-hmi-lab.github.io/HyrCap
result.summary: Temporal action detection in long untrimmed videos suffers from inaccurate localization and low-quality proposals, especially with sparse annotations and ambiguous boundaries. For open-ended video understanding and LLM-driven event analysis, reliable proposals connect temporal localization, event annotation, and semantic understanding. However, conventional temporal action detection (TAD) pipelines lack explicit modeling of proposal localization quality, cross-representation support, and inter-proposal relations. We propose Hybrid Rank-Calibration of Action Proposals (HyrCap), a proposal-centric query-based TAD framework for temporal event understanding. Hybrid combines complementary video features with different localization cues, while Rank-Calibration adjusts proposal ranking confidence to reflect localization reliability and candidate competition. HyrCap treats dense query-based predictions as an over-complete temporal event hypothesis space. Cross-Representation Consensus Calibration, Localization Quality Estimation, and Proposal Redundancy Suppression improve proposal ranking reliability, localization quality, and candidate discrimination. Inspired by LLMs' capabilities in fine-grained semantic recognition, event description, and reasoning, we introduce HyrCap for Semantic Action Understanding, using calibrated proposals for standard TAD and as inputs to LLM-based semantic understanding. We define a staged evaluation protocol to separately measure event localization, segment-level semantic understanding, and combined event understanding performance. Experiments on public benchmarks show that HyrCap achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple metrics and provides a finer-grained paradigm and evaluation protocol for query-based event segmentation and annotation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HyrCap 这一以提案为中心的查询式时序动作检测框架，用混合视频特征与排序校准（跨表示共识校准、定位质量估计、冗余抑制）提升提案可靠性，并把校准后的提案输入 LLM 做事件语义理解与分阶段评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其把密集查询预测视为「过完备事件假设空间」并依赖可靠性与候选竞争来校准排序、抑制冗余，可能为 LVR 的证据筛选与停止决策提供可核查的排序/校验线索，但本身不涉及 latent 推理状态。
